observations.body: Hagar and Sarah are reread as two covenants. Tell me, you that desire to be under the law, don’t you listen to the law? So then, brothers, we are not children of a servant, but of the free woman.
observations.label: Hagar and Sarah are reread as two covenants

payload.posture: Read Galatians 4:21–31 as one movement in Paul's story, keeping the passage's actions, setting, sequence, and limits visible.
payload.tension: The passage states hagar and Sarah are reread as two covenants. Tell me, you that desire to be under the law, don’t you listen to the law? So then, brothers, we are not children of a servant, but of the free woman. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of Paul's story.
